name: Standard Industrial Robot Line Capabilities (v1)
description: Standard semantics for AI-agent control of industrial robot stations on a production line: which station may be actuated, which motion/parameter operations are allowed, and the parameter bounds (speed, angle, batch) that the principal authorized. Stations are categorical identifiers, encoded per CLC-v1 §6.2 (v1.1) as an allowed-set ARRAY in grants: {"station":[3]} grants ONLY station 3 (NOT 1 or 2). Operations may send a scalar station, resolved as set membership.
author: varwof (open ecosystem)
note: IMPORTANT: AIC/CLC authorize *who may command what*, they are not a functional-safety mechanism. E-stop, safety PLC, light curtains and interlocks (IEC 61508 / ISO 13849 / GB 11291) MUST remain independent of this authorization layer.

capabilities.summary: Begin normal production on the named station
capabilities.when_not: Must not be granted when the station is in maintenance or a human is inside the cell

capabilities.summary: Orderly stop of the named station
capabilities.when_not: Emergency stop is a safety function and MUST NOT be modeled here

capabilities.summary: Move a single joint on the named station within angle/speed bounds
capabilities.when_not: Must not be granted with unbounded speed in a cell with human access

capabilities.summary: Move the tool center point linearly within the cell envelope
capabilities.when_not: Must not be granted without a cell-envelope bound (x/y/z)

capabilities.summary: Change the maximum motion speed allowed for the station
capabilities.usage: Supervisor reduces speed for a shift or a sensitive batch
capabilities.when_not: Must not be granted to raise speed above the safety-rated limit

capabilities.summary: Bind the station to an approved process recipe identifier
capabilities.when_not: Must not be granted for unapproved recipe ids

capabilities.summary: Replace the station trajectory with an approved point list
capabilities.usage: Process engineer tuning during a changeover
capabilities.when_not: Must not be granted while the cell is running with humans present

capabilities.summary: Adjust controller gains/offsets within engineering bounds
capabilities.when_not: Must not be granted while the station is in production

capabilities.description: Put a station into maintenance mode
capabilities.summary: Enter maintenance state; production capabilities are suspended
capabilities.usage: Maintenance staff, normally with step-up approval
capabilities.when_not: Must not be granted without an audit trail

capabilities.description: Break-glass override of a guard interlock
capabilities.summary: Exceptional override; requires strong audit and post-hoc review
capabilities.usage: Only for maintenance with two-person confirmation
capabilities.when_not: Must never be granted silently; MUST be break-glass with supervisor approval
